findings.text: Upheld as advisory (Q9/Q3). Checked at repo.ts:195-200: every readdirSync error except ENOENT, including EIO, EMFILE and EPERM, becomes 'cannot be listed ... make it readable' with code invalid, and the errno is dropped. It fails closed as round five asked; the message names a cause it never checked. Fix: append error.code.

Upheld as advisory (Q10). The docs of the walk (180-188) and of refuseForeign (139-140) say a .git holding anything but regular files and folders is refused. Neither names the FSMONITOR_SOCKET exception the code makes at line 207.

Upheld as advisory (Q3). refuseLinkedRoots also refuses a plain file or any other non-folder (lines 85-89), and refuseLinksInside also refuses unlistable folders and sockets. The names say less than the functions do. The rule itself is written once.
Upheld as advisory (Q2). headOfGitDir repeats readGitInfo's HEAD parsing in the same file, and only this copy gains the refs/ rule (63-66), so the two parsers follow different rules.

Upheld as advisory (Q6). list and adopt now print as each repository finishes, but rebuild still prints only after rebuildAll's loop. A later fault therefore loses the lines for repositories already rebuilt.
Upheld as advisory (Q5/Q8), carried. readIntent is a one-line forwarder to readRecord, and only tests import it.
Upheld as advisory (Q5), carried. keepBytes' default name and its return value are used only by tests.
Upheld as advisory (Q2), carried. adopt repeats underLeases' lease nesting.
Upheld as advisory (Q4/Q5), carried. Three knobs are set only by tests: GitOptions.timeoutMs, resolveRepo's folderName and DoctorContext.gitVersion.
Upheld as advisory (Q8), carried. moduleVersion and readEntry are exports that only tests import.
Upheld as advisory (Q2), carried. foldersByHand and projectFolders copy resolve.ts's folder listing.
Lowered to advisory as debt. readGitInfo, on the hook path and untouched by the diff, still follows any ref: in HEAD.
Lowered to advisory as debt. The 'db as Db' cast of a possibly null database is outside the change; the diff repeats it at checks.ts:617.

Upheld as advisory (Q1). With a database, scanRepos throws the same refusal, so deleting the doctor's own refuseLinkedRoots call leaves doctor-knowledge.test.ts:248 green. The no-database path that only line 610 guards is untested.
Upheld as advisory. The fixture leaves no intent record, so moving refuseForeign after revertInterrupted survives the test. The 'refused before git runs' ordering is only partly held.
Upheld as advisory. The socket test holds the name only. Dropping entry.isSocket() or 'folder === gitDir' leaves the suite green.
Upheld as advisory. Two of the four refs return null without the new check. The parts[0] !== 'refs' clause at git.ts:64 is held by no case; the '..' clause is held.
Upheld as advisory. No test holds the new print-as-it-goes promise of adopt and list. The fault test faults in the first repository, so stdout is empty under either code.
Upheld as advisory, carried. No test holds underOwnLease's 'started ||' rule.
Upheld as advisory, carried. Nothing tests what the commands print for a listed folder with no repository.
Upheld as advisory, carried. Swapping record-first and kept bytes in adoptIn leaves the suite green.
Upheld as advisory, carried. No test adds a file during a write's git calls; this is a stated known limit.
Upheld as advisory, carried (Q5). The rebuild-order test depends on the internal renewal count.
Upheld as advisory, carried (AC-8). Only the version probe times out, and the test does not check that the process is gone.
Upheld as advisory, carried (AC-2). The parent's .gitignore weakens the empty-status proof.
Upheld as advisory, carried (AC-13). Clipping is checked on the thrown message, not on the log line.
Upheld as advisory, carried (AC-2). The test resolves through the knowledge_repos row, not through the manifest.

Upheld as advisory, as filed: hardening beyond the named risk areas, with no personal data exposed. Verified that objects/ subfolders are not walked and configArgs sets neither gc.auto nor maintenance.auto. probes/auto-gc.md did not reproduce the detached gc or the deletion through a linked objects/info/commit-graphs on git 2.54 (six-second wait), so the path stays reasoned. Cheap fix: -c gc.auto=0 -c maintenance.auto=false.

Upheld as advisory. headOfGitDir splits the ref on '/' only, so on Windows a ref such as 'refs/..\..\outside' passes. The effect is availability and probing only, and Windows is reasoned, not run. Refuse '\' and ':' as git does.
Upheld as advisory. The exported readTaxonomy reaches taxonomyFor with no refuseLinkedRoots or refuseForeign. Its only current caller runs after ensureRepo, so no path reaches it today.
Upheld as advisory, carried. A leftover lock or MERGE_HEAD fails as code git and stops inEachRepo for every repository. Availability only.
Upheld as advisory, carried. A dropped intent record is read whole (NO_CAP) before it is rejected. Availability only.
Upheld as advisory, carried. The refusal messages at 199 and 211 put a dropped entry name raw on stderr, which allows terminal escapes. Hardening outside the risk areas.

Upheld as advisory (Q1/Q2). A person who linked knowledge/ on purpose now has every command fail loudly, with nothing written. The message's 'Remove it' does not name the safe way back (link the data directory, or WIZARDINGCODE_HOME). Recovery exists and is manual.

Upheld as advisory (Q1). Every non-ENOENT listing error becomes the same permissions refusal with code invalid and no log line, so a disk fault (EIO, EMFILE, EPERM) reads as a permissions hint. It fails closed. Same point as code-quality F-1.

Upheld as advisory (Q1). configArgs does not turn off gc.auto. A detached gc may contend for locks after thousands of writes; the failed write is undone and a retry works. Reasoned; probes/auto-gc.md did not trigger it.
Upheld as advisory, carried. A locked lease or a timeout stops the later repositories, and a partial result exits 1 like a total failure. Earlier lines are now printed.
Upheld as advisory, carried. The adopt 'was undone' report overstates in the unstaged and JSON-parse-failure cases.
Upheld as advisory, carried. The 'not one this version writes' message also covers a corrupt record and a folder at the record's path.

Upheld as advisory, not a defect. The spec's risks text is stale on rebuild's handling of a corrupt repository and on 'backed up like any folder'. The rollback is stated at spec.md:321, no unstated dependency is named, and ADR 0024 records the newer behaviour as the later text. Under the risk rubric this is a manual-rollback or wording advisory.
Upheld as advisory, carried and stated in Known limits. The module migration pass is not contained, and earlier branch builds leave unused folders behind.
Lowered to advisory as debt, outside the change. lint processes 0 files in this worktree.

Lowered to advisory as debt, which predates this item. The upgrade runner waits up to 10 s under BEGIN IMMEDIATE.

Upheld as advisory. CLAUDE.md says 'the same two guards', but the doctor now copies three by hand: refuseLinkedRoots, refuseForeign and checkRepoConfig. Nothing ties the doctor's copies to openRepo's. Name the guards.
Upheld as advisory (Q1/Q6). The refs/ rule is placed correctly in core, but headOfGitDir's docstring does not state it, and core now has two HEAD readers with different rules.
Upheld as advisory, carried. Function-level import cycles remain (repo.ts and resolve.ts, repo.ts and author.ts); this commit adds no new edge.
Upheld as advisory, carried. The spec's Design is not amended. ADR 0024 declares itself the later text and records each behaviour.
Lowered to advisory as debt. readGitInfo predates this item and is untouched.
Lowered to advisory as debt, carried. The doctor's hand-built folder listing copies resolve.ts.
Lowered to advisory as debt, carried. SettingKey omits two keys.
Lowered to advisory as debt, carried. No forward reference to ADR 0024.

Upheld as a defect (Q1: a data loss a reader of the diff can name). rebuildAll deletes a repository's knowledge_entries, knowledge_proposals and knowledge_repos rows whenever isDirectory is false. isDirectory (repo.ts:117-123) returns false on every lstat error, EACCES included, and refuseLinkedRoots (repo.ts:85) skips a root that existsOnDisk cannot stat. probes/rebuild-unsearchable-root.md ran it: with knowledge/projects at mode 000, and again at 600, rebuild returned with refused 0, deleted the project repository's row and its entry row while the folder and its files stayed on disk, and the row never came back. For a project with no remote, that row is the only tie to its folder. Fix: treat only ENOENT as gone, and refuse a root or repository path that cannot be stat'ed or listed.

Upheld as advisory (Q3/Q5). A HEAD that is not under refs/ reads as no commit: its rows stay as last indexed, and a write touches only the store's own .gitignore before failing. These are states git itself refuses.
Upheld as advisory, carried (Q1). The irreversible DELETE FROM meta has its reason stated beside it and runs after the pre-upgrade backup.
Upheld as advisory, carried (Q3). The post-commit fingerprint is a stated known limit.
Upheld as advisory, carried (Q6). The one-time VACUUM INTO backup under the write lock has not been timed.
Upheld as advisory, carried (Q2). project_aliases is read by an unindexed project_id, on a write path over a small table.
Lowered to advisory as debt, outside the change. project_aliases has no index on project_id.
